## Clip Engine 1.0.0

Clip Engine 1.0 is here. It edits, keeps a journal of your runs, shows your PC's stats, records every audio source on its own track, saves a clip when you say so, and has a hub for everyone's clips on the web.

- **A video editor.** Press **Edit** on any clip to split it, trim each part, cut what you don't need, put parts in another order and export a new clip with its moments kept. Undo and redo work, and an edit is kept so you can come back to it.
- **A journal of every run.** The new **Journal** page tells each run in ARC Raiders, Hunt: Showdown 1896, Escape from Tarkov, Helldivers 2 and Deep Rock Galactic as a short story: the map, your loadout, what you took down and picked up, how it ended, and what you lost if you died. It keeps records like your longest run and best extraction streak. Hunt's journal is exact; the others read the screen and will get sharper with your feedback. Turn it off in Settings.
- **Say "clip that".** Turn on voice clips in Settings and say a phrase you pick to save the last moments. Windows' own speech recognition listens on your PC, and nothing you say leaves it.
- **Audio on its own tracks.** The game, your mic, Discord and other apps each get a track, after one with everything mixed. Turn any of them down or mute it from Settings, even mid-game.
- **Up to 30 minutes of replay.** Keep as much as half an hour ready to save. Settings shows the memory it takes and warns you when your PC would struggle.
- **Stats overlay.** Press **Alt+Shift+F** for a slim strip in a corner of the game with your frame rate, 1% lows, CPU, GPU and its temperature, video memory and RAM. It never touches the game and never shows up in your clips.
- **The hub.** Everyone's public clips on the web, newest or most watched, by game, and searchable. Sign in from your phone or any browser with one click in the app (**Cloud > Open the hub**) to choose who can see each clip. Shared clips, profiles and the website now work well on phones too.
- **More themes for supporters.** Pro now has 13 colours. Ultra gets all 16, a colour wheel for any colour, and adaptive themes with gradients and livelier buttons, all switchable in Settings.
- **Your badge, your call.** Pro, Ultra and Content Creator badges show next to your name. Hide yours from the app or the hub.
- **Get Pro free.** Invite friends from the **Friends** page. When three of them install Clip Engine on their own PCs and start it, you get a month of Pro.
- **Donate any amount.** Donate once from **Settings > Plan** or the website to help keep Clip Engine going. You get a **Supporter** badge, 1 GB more cloud storage for every dollar (up to 25 GB), and from $5 your name in the credits.
- **Special keys.** Content Creator, Special and Exclusive keys show their role as your badge, can put your name in the credits, and some come with a **Talk to the developer** box for messages and bug reports.

New here? Download `Clip_Engine-Setup.exe` and run it. If you already have Clip Engine, update from Settings.
